introHtml: Golf tournaments and outings create opportunities to share your brand with players who appreciate practical, high-quality giveaways. Custom medical healthcare items designed for the course — like portable first aid kits, blister bandages, and sunscreen packets — show you care about their comfort and safety. These products are small enough to fit in a golf bag yet useful enough to be remembered long after the round ends. Choose from options that withstand sun, sweat, and a day on the greens.
